summaryZh: HXI 实验室开发感知、智能和沉浸式技术，以理解人类行为并在关键行动时提供数字信息。研究重点是医疗与健康等高时效场景，采用多模态环境感知、沉浸可视化、现场需求发现、参与式设计与真实环境原型评估。

evidence.quote: The H uman-centered e X tended I ntelligence Research Lab investigates, designs and develops tools, techniques and infrastructure that capture, quantify and interpret human behavior, and bring digital information to the point of action.
multimodal pervasive sensing and immersive visualization.

Every project begins with need-finding in the field: real-world problems identified with clinicians, patients and other stakeholders, solutions designed with them, and prototypes evaluated in real-world settings for ecological validity.
The HXI Research Lab is part of the Computer Science & Engineering Department at UCSD
